Hi team,

Quick note — Aurora's CTO (Sara) just confirmed they can only join in the evening window on Oct 9 (between 17:30-19:00 PT) due to travel. They also asked if their VP (internal sponsor) might be added as a late attendee; the VP is available but only on Oct 9 from 18:00-18:30 PT.

Current demo is scheduled 2025-10-09 10:00 PT. Given the exec availability, can we:
- shift the customer-facing demo to Oct 9 at 17:30 PT (60m) to ensure CTO presence?
- compress the agenda slightly so VP can join for the last 20–30 minutes (we'll save the executive summary for that window)?

Marcus — can you confirm engineer coverage if we move to evening? Karthik — can you confirm we can compress the technical walkthrough and still hit the core success criteria? Laura — I'll need you to update the calendar and send a fresh invite to Aurora (Sara + VP).

I'm attaching the current deck and an .ics with a couple of proposed slots. If evening isn't acceptable for any reason, we should propose a fallback: Oct 10 morning with CTO dial-in only (less ideal).

Thanks,
Evelyn
